archetype: Civic Tech Authority & High-Integrity Institutional System (Swiss & High-Contrast with Deep Civic Navy and Sovereign Gold Accents)
emotional_tone: Unwavering Trust, High Security, Verifiable Democracy, Clean Institutional Precision

rules.labels: font-sans uppercase text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400
rules.code_hashes: font-mono text-xs tracking-tight bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 px-2 py-1 rounded

colors.palette_summary: Civic Deep Navy (#0B192C / #0F2038), Crisp White / Warm Slate (#F8FAFC), Sovereign Saffron-Gold (#D97706 / #F59E0B) for active democracy cues, Emerald Green (#059669) for verified states, Crimson Red (#DC2626) for alerts/suspended, and Cobalt (#1D4ED8) for primary civic CTAs.

entry_surfaces./: Institutional civic hero with trust badge over deep navy gradient, 3-pillar proof cards (Identity, Liveness, Blockchain Ledger), live election banner, and quick portal routes
entry_surfaces./login: Dual authentication entry hub — Voter Sovereign Login (Aadhaar/OTP/Face) left panel vs Admin Security MFA gateway right panel
entry_surfaces./voter-login: Branded single-column civic access portal with Aadhaar / Voter ID credentials, instant OTP verification test simulator, and biometrics readiness badge
entry_surfaces./admin-login: High-security command-center MFA split login with sandbox 6-digit authenticator code and role selector badge
entry_surfaces./voter/register: Multi-step citizen registration wizard with live progress indicator, Aadhaar sandbox lookup, consent declaration, and photo submission
entry_surfaces./voter/face-verification: Interactive civic biometrics workstation with live camera viewport, elliptical alignment overlay, liveness challenge prompter, and real-time confidence meter
entry_surfaces./results: Public transparency ledger with election constituency selector, turnout metrics, donut and bar breakdown charts, and one-click cryptographic integrity verification

public.header: Clean white/glass sticky navbar (`z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200`) containing Indian National Emblem-inspired civic crest, navigation links (Home, How It Works, Security & Blockchain, Live Results, FAQ, Status), System Health Badge, and Dual Login Dropdown/Buttons.
public.footer: Substantial institutional dark footer (`bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 py-16`) with citizen charter, security disclaimers, encryption specs, emergency audit contacts, and government compliance links.

voter_portal.layout: Citizen-centric focused workflow: clean top header with Aadhaar mask ID, active verification status badge, remaining voting time, security status, and breadcrumbs navigation. Mobile bottom bar for Dashboard, Elections, Receipt, Security.
voter_portal.ballot_experience: Distraction-free, single-screen candidate selection with verified party symbols, candidate manifesto preview, instant selection confirmation, vote review sheet, and cryptographic receipt issuance (SHA-256 vote hash + block index).

admin_portal.layout: Institutional command center: fixed left sidebar (`w-64 bg-[#0B192C] text-slate-200`) with categorized navigation (Overview, Election Engine, Voter & KYC, Fraud & Security, Blockchain Explorer, Live Analytics, Settings) and top navbar with active Admin Role badge, system load status, notifications, and MFA session indicator.
admin_portal.mobile: Collapsible sheet drawer with full menu parity and bottom quick-action bar.

motion_and_animations.philosophy: Subtle, purposeful, non-distracting. Respects government and civic tech accessibility standards (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`).

key_interactions.face_detection_scan: Gentle pulsing scanline across the face viewfinder during capture (`ease-in-out` 2s loop).
key_interactions.liveness_challenge_transition: Smooth slide-in of new instructions (Blink -> Turn Right -> Smile) using standard opacity/transform fade.
key_interactions.vote_submission: Step-by-step verification progress with checkmark reveals (Encrypting ballot -> Mining block -> Committing ledger -> Generating receipt).
key_interactions.integrity_verify: One-click hash verification calculation with green confirmation burst.

accessibility_and_compliance.wcag_level: WCAG 2.2 AA / AAA for text and touch targets
accessibility_and_compliance.min_touch_targets: 44px by 44px for buttons and ballot voting actions
accessibility_and_compliance.focus_states: 3px solid #1D4ED8 with 2px offset on all interactive elements
accessibility_and_compliance.test_attributes: Every interactive and status element MUST feature a unique `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="voter-aadhaar-input"`, `data-testid="candidate-vote-button-1"`, `data-testid="blockchain-verify-btn"`, `data-testid="election-status-badge"`).

critical_flows_to_implement: 2. Complete Sandbox Voter Journey: Registration -> Aadhaar OTP / Mock API verification -> Consent -> Webcam Face Verification (with realistic mock video/feed + fallback) -> Server Liveness Challenges (Blink, Turn Left, Turn Right, Smile) -> Voter Dashboard

3. Sovereign Ballot Cast Flow: Voter Dashboard -> Eligible Election -> Candidate Manifesto -> Cast Vote -> Confirmation Modal with biometric re-verify -> Cryptographic Receipt (Vote Hash, Block Index, Merkle Proof, Timestamp) -> Ballot Verification Tool

4. Institutional Admin Command Center: Multi-role Login with Sandbox MFA code (default: 123456 or generated) -> Admin Dashboard with Recharts (hourly votes, constituency turnout, fraud radar) -> Full Election State Machine (DRAFT -> SCHEDULED -> OPEN -> CLOSED -> COUNTING -> RESULTS_PUBLISHED -> ARCHIVED) with danger confirmations -> Candidate/Constituency/Voter CRUD -> Live Voting Monitor -> Fraud & Security Sentinel -> Append-only Audit Logs -> Blockchain Explorer with 'Verify Election Integrity' cryptographic validation
5. Public Results Portal (`/results`): Interactive constituency filtering, winner badges, turnout percentages, Recharts bar & donut visualizations, and 'Verify Result Integrity' cryptographic checker
6. System Status Dashboard showing real-time health of Identity Provider Sandbox, Face Verification engine, MongoDB Database, Blockchain Ledger, and Email/SMS notification dispatcher

7. Seed mock data with realistic Indian constituencies (e.g., New Delhi Central, Mumbai South, Bengaluru South, Varanasi, Chennai Central) and real-looking candidates with party symbols, manifestos, and voting records

code_architecture.backend: FastAPI with routers for `auth`, `elections`, `voters`, `candidates`, `ballots`, `blockchain`, `audit`, and `system_status`. MongoDB async motor indexes on all query fields.
code_architecture.frontend: React 19 with Vite, Tailwind v4, `@tanstack/react-query`, Shadcn UI primitives, Recharts, and Sonner toasts.
